shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -40 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/controls components/layout hooks; cat hooks/useFileInput/*.d.ts; cat components/Select/types.d.ts | head -120; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts | head -80

cat components/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; cat components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; cat components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems" | head; grep -rn "Divider\b" components/Divider/Divider.d.ts | head -3; ls components/Toaster; ls ../../../icons | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 1,40p components/Alert/types.d.ts; cat components/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -n "loading\|view?\|type?" | head; grep -n "export" components/layout/index.d.ts
grep -n "^export type ButtonView\|ButtonButtonProps\|interface ButtonCommonProps" -A3 components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "export.*Card\b\|view?" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head
cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js; grep -n "id\b\|id:" components/Select/Select.js | head; grep -n "id" components/Select/components/SelectControl/SelectControl.js | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "type" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js | head -5; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
